[Lanka Talks] The Body Shop Spotlights Its Iconic Tea Tree Range for Sri Lanka's Tropical Climate
item.description: In Sri Lanka’s warm tropical climate, high humidity and heat make maintaining clear, balanced, and fresh skin a year-round challenge. To combat excess oiliness, shine, and humidity-induced breakouts, British-born international ethical beauty brand The Body Shop spotlights its legendary Tea Tree Range in Sri Lanka - the ultimate daily routine to keep skin and hair purified, matte, and healthy in tropical weather.

item.title: [Lanka Talks] Government-led IDAT Programme advances data-driven decision-making across Sri Lanka’s fisheries and plantation sectors
item.description: The Government of Sri Lanka has advanced a key national digital transformation priority through the launch and handover of Decision Support Systems for the fisheries and plantation sectors under the Inclusive Digital Agriculture Transformation Programme, known as IDAT. The Government-led initiative is designed to strengthen how public institutions collect, integrate and use data to guide policy, planning, resource allocation and service delivery.

item.title: [Ada Derana Biz English] Seylan Bank appoints Krishan Thilakaratne as Deputy Chairman
item.description:
Seylan Bank PLC has announced the appointment of Mr. Krishan Thilakaratne, Non‑Executive Director, as the Deputy Chairman of the Board with effect from 17th August 2026.
Mr. Thilakaratne was appointed as a Non-Executive Director to the Board in 2018, and the progression to Deputy Chairman, reaffirms his long‑standing governance role and leadership capacity.
He currently serves as Director/CEO of LOLC Finance PLC and is a member of the Senior Management Team of LOLC Holdings PLC.
